questions.Description: Create a scene containing a Box, Sphere, Cylinder, and Teapot. Modify the creation parameters of each object (e.g., segments, radius, height). Demonstrate the ability to move, rotate, and scale each object independently.

Create a Cylinder. Apply the "Bend" and "Taper" modifiers to the Cylinder. Adjust the parameters of each modifier to create a visibly altered shape. Document the transformation values and modifier parameters used
Design and build a simple scene using only standard primitives. The scene should contain at least five objects and demonstrate an understanding of object placement and composition.

Create a complex 2D spline using the Line tool, incorporating both curved and straight segments. Combine a Circle and Rectangle shape into a single editable spline. Modify the combined shape using the "Outline" and "Fillet" modifiers.

Create a 2D spline representing a simple architectural element (e.g., a picture frame). Apply the "Extrude" modifier to create a 3D object. Create a text shape and apply the "Bevel" modifier to create a 3D logo
Create a series of contour lines using 2D splines. Use the "Terrain" compound object to generate a 3D terrain surface. Modify the terrain using the paint deformation tools.
Model a simple object (part of a vehicle) using Editable Poly techniques. Demonstrate the use of the "Connect," "Bridge," and "Smooth" modifiers.
Create a basic 3D scene using polygon objects. The scene should contain at least three distinct objects and demonstrate an understanding of scene composition and object placement

Create a scene with standard primitives. Add a "Target Camera" and position it to frame the scene. Add a "Standard Omni" light and a "Standard Target Directional" light. Adjust the light and camera parameters to achieve a visually appealing render.

Create a simple animation. Enable "Object Motion Blur" and "Depth of Field" in the camera settings. Render a frame from the animation demonstrating these effects. Document the parameter adjustments made.

Create a simple scene with standard primitives. Open the Material Editor and create three different materials with varying diffuse, specular, and texture settings. Apply these materials to the objects in the scene. Model a simple object, apply a UVW map, and apply a material modifier with a noise map in the bump slot.
